verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev is explicitly built for autonomous background execution: durable, retryable, long-running tasks with no timeouts, scheduled/cron triggers, queues, concurrency control, versioning, waitpoints for pausing/resuming, and realtime status streaming — all confirmed by docs and validated by hands-on community use (migrating from n8n, running AI/chat pipelines, screenshot jobs) and independent runtime probes (working CLI, MCP server, live auth-gated API). Missing for 10: no independent benchmark of true unattended multi-day autonomy at scale, and some community friction around v3→v4 migration and self-hosting tradeoffs slightly tempers confidence in seamless long-term autonomous operation.
